title: Design and evaluation of AI copilots – case studies of retail copilot templates

bias_targets.methodology: Simulating adversarial user queries (red-teaming) and prompt injections to evaluate the copilot's susceptibility to generating unsafe content, hate speech, or information that harms specific groups.

Identified as a methodological risk during the AI-assisted evaluation process where the evaluating language model exhibits a preference for responses generated by the same model over those from other models or humans.
